title: A daily journal prompt
request:
Build a daily journal prompt. A signed-in person chooses a time of day and a
time zone on the page at /eval-scheduled-01, and every day at that time a
scheduled run stores the day's prompt in their personal storage; the page shows
the latest one. A visitor who is not signed in sees a link to sign in, and a
POST to /eval-scheduled-01/schedule from them answers 401. The prompts are, in
order: "What made you smile today?", "What did you learn today?", "What will
you do differently tomorrow?". Put the choice in lib/prompts.ts as an exported
function promptFor(day: number): string that answers the prompt for that day
number, starting again from the first after the last, and write tests for it.
